picker_description: You belong to several organizations. Pick one to continue.
picker_empty_description: You are not a member of any organization. Ask an organization owner to invite you.
home_description: You are signed in to this organization as {{role}}.
gate_not_member_description: You are not a member of “{{slug}}”, or it does not exist.
gate_suspended_description: “{{slug}}” is suspended. Contact the platform administrator.
gate_expired_description: The access period of “{{slug}}” has ended. Contact the platform administrator.
gate_disabled_description: This application does not have organizations switched on.
gate_error_description: Something went wrong while checking your access. Try again.
members_description: People in this organization and their roles.
members_remove_description: They lose access to this organization immediately.
members_leave_description: You lose access to this organization. An owner can invite you again.
invitations_description: Open invitations. Each link works once.
roles_page_description: Roles in your office and their permissions. Template roles cannot be deleted; you can add roles of your own.
roles_delete_description: The role is deleted permanently. Move its members to another role first.
roles_delete_in_use: This role has members; move them to another role before deleting it.
roles_dialog_description: Set the role's name, description and permissions.
roles_key_hint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2–32 characters). Cannot be changed later.
roles_owner_locked: The owner role always holds every permission; its permissions cannot be changed.
roles_grant_hint: You can only add permissions you hold. Permissions the role already has may stay or be removed.
settings_description: Your office name; it shows in the menu and in the taxpayer portal. The address (short name) is managed by the platform.
accept_wrong_account: You are signed in as {{current}}. Sign in as {{email}} to accept this invitation.
accept_status_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
accept_not_found_description: The link is invalid or incomplete. Check the address in your email.
settings_section_ai_description: Auto-approval and rule candidate settings apply to every taxpayer of the office.
settings_section_support_description: Your taxpayers' support requests reach your office directly through ClickFix.
support_card_description: The Support button in the taxpayer portal opens this support window; requests land in your office's ClickFix inbox. Leave it empty to use the platform's default support channel.
support_widget_help: Paste the id (data-widget) shown on the Web widget → Install tab of the ClickFix panel.
support_widget_invalid: Only letters, digits, - and _ are allowed (up to 128 characters).
settings_section_sms_description: SMS to your clients go from your office's own NetGSM account and sender name. Every send is recorded as proof.
sms_card_description: Enter the API sub-user you created at NetGSM. The password is stored encrypted and never shown here again.
sms_enabled_help: While off, no automation or bulk send sends SMS.
sms_test_mode_help: While on, messages are only recorded, not sent to NetGSM.
sms_test_mode_server_off: Real sending is off on this server; messages are only recorded.
sms_usercode_invalid: The subscriber number has digits only.
sms_password_help: The password you set for the API sub-user in the NetGSM panel.
sms_password_keep: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
sms_msgheader_help: An approved header at NetGSM, 3 to 11 characters. Pick one from the connection test.
sms_msgheader_invalid: The sender name must be 3 to 11 characters.
sms_headers_pick: Approved sender names on your account; pick one and save.
sms_help_step1: Create an API sub-user in the NetGSM panel.
sms_help_step2: Enable API access for that sub-user.
sms_help_step3: If IP restriction is on, add our server's IP address to the allow list.
sms_test_message_help: Send a test message to your own number. In test mode it is only recorded.
sms_test_message_disabled: Turn SMS sending on and save before sending a test SMS.
sms_test_message_text: This is a test message. Your SMS connection works.
sms_test_message_dry_run: Test mode: the message was recorded, not sent.
statement_ai_label: Let AI suggest columns for unrecognised statements
statement_ai_description: When off, the file is not sent to AI; columns are suggested from templates and header names, and you pick the rest in the preview.
settings_section_tax_returns_description: Who does the final check of a return.
final_check_on: On: everyone prepares returns; only the office owner or an admin marks them checked and filed.
final_check_off: Off: whoever prepares a return can also mark it checked and filed. Who and when are still recorded.
important_docs_label: Show "Important documents" on the taxpayer page and in the taxpayer panel
important_docs_on: On: documents such as the tax certificate and signature circular sit in their own section; expiring ones are highlighted and the taxpayer downloads the shared ones.
important_docs_off: Off: the section is hidden. The documents stay in the archive.
z_parts_label: Allow a long Z report to be uploaded as several photos
z_parts_on: On: the taxpayer and the office capture a long Z report as parts 1/2/3; the parts become one Z report.
z_parts_off: Off: a Z report is uploaded with one photo only.
settings_section_automations_description: Send filing and payment reminders automatically with rules. Each taxpayer gets one per period; no marketing messages.
automation_master_help: When off, no rule runs; your rules are kept.
automation_delete_description: The rule "{{name}}" is deleted. Past sends stay on record.
automation_dialog_description: Choose when, to whom and on which channel. Each taxpayer gets it once per period.
automation_preview_empty: The preview shows here once you type the text.
automation_days_help: You can pick several days. 31 means the last day of the month.
automation_current_period: The period is the current month
automation_resend: Resend after N days if still unpaid (0 = no)
automation_delay_help: The message goes out within this window, during office hours.
automation_only_due: Only send to those with a payment or missing item
automation_unopened: Send SMS if the email is not opened
automation_variables_help: Click a tag to insert it into the text.
automation_approval_draft: Hold as draft for my approval
automation_history_description: Every send and rule change is kept on record.
automation_drafts_description: Messages prepared by draft-mode rules are waiting for your approval.
settings_section_vat_description: See every taxpayer's VAT position before the month ends.
vat_report_label: Show the month-end VAT report on the Reports page
vat_report_on: On: each taxpayer's sales and purchase VAT for this month, carried-forward VAT and whether a payment is due appear in one table.
vat_report_off: Off: the report is hidden. VAT details on taxpayer pages stay the same.
vat_report_day: Day the report counts as ready
vat_report_day_option_late: Day {{day}} of the month (last day in shorter months)
vat_watch_on: On: every morning this month's VAT of each taxpayer is computed. If the status told to the taxpayer (payment due or not) changes with a new invoice, or the payable passes the threshold, the office is notified.
vat_watch_off: Off: no daily check; no "VAT status changed" or "VAT threshold exceeded" notifications.
vat_watch_limit_label: Warn when the VAT payable exceeds
vat_watch_limit_invalid: Enter an amount above zero (e.g. 10000) or leave the box empty.
vat_watch_limit_hint_set: When a taxpayer's VAT payable this month reaches {{amount}}, a "VAT threshold exceeded" alert is raised; it also shows on the Warnings page. Empty the box and save to turn the threshold alert off.
vat_watch_limit_hint_empty: No threshold: only "VAT status changed" alerts are raised. Enter an amount and save.
vat_watch_channel_hint: Alerts go to the office members assigned to the taxpayer, or to the office owner when nobody is assigned.
vat_watch_save_error: The VAT watch setting could not be saved.
vat_alerts_hint: The latest alerts the watch raised across the office. Click a taxpayer to open the VAT card.
vat_alerts_empty: No VAT alerts yet. The watch runs every morning; taxpayers over the threshold or with a changed status show up here.
vat_alerts_error: The latest VAT alerts could not be loaded.
vat_rules_hint: On which days, to whom and for which taxpayers the report is prepared. For example the 15th as a mid-month report for the office only, the 29th for taxpayers with a payment due. Each run sends a "VAT report ready" notification; the communication centre's automations can trigger on it.
vat_rules_who_payable: Only those with a payment due
vat_rules_pick_description: This rule runs only for the taxpayers you pick.
vat_rules_pick_search: Search by name or tax ID
vat_rules_ran: VAT report prepared for {{taxpayers}} taxpayers; {{payable}} have a payment due.
vat_rules_save_error: The rules could not be saved.
settings_section_taxpayer_panel_descript: What taxpayers see in their own panel.
taxpayer_vat_panel_label: Show VAT and sales report in the taxpayer panel
taxpayer_vat_panel_on: On: the taxpayer sees this month's estimated VAT, the due date, total sales, top buyers and recent months' sales.
taxpayer_vat_panel_off: Off: the section is hidden in the taxpayer panel; the figures stay in the office.
settings_section_foreign_invoices_descri: VAT 2 and withholding on services bought from abroad; the return is filed in Luca.
settings_section_exchange_rates_descript: Foreign-currency invoices take their rate from the TCMB daily rates automatically; VAT and the TL amount use it.
fx_label: Fill missing rates from TCMB automatically
fx_on: On: foreign-currency invoices and foreign service invoices without a rate take the rate of the last TCMB bulletin before the invoice date. A rate you enter never changes.
fx_off: Off: no automatic rate; you enter the rate of invoices without one.
fx_kind_hint: Automatic rates move to the new kind at once; confirmed foreign invoices and rates entered by hand do not change.
fx_failed: Could not save the exchange rate setting.
foreign_label: Show the "Foreign invoices / VAT 2" tab on the taxpayer page
foreign_on: On: invoices such as Google Ads, AWS and software licences are collected month by month; KDV2 and stopaj are calculated and the office confirms. The taxpayer can send invoices from the panel (Upload documents) or WhatsApp; the ready-made "Send your foreign invoices" rule (1st of the month) can be turned on in Automations.
foreign_off: Off: the tab is hidden; the taxpayer panel upload, the WhatsApp "Foreign invoice" save and the reminder rule do not work. Entered invoices are kept.
foreign_kinds_hint: Picking a service kind when adding an invoice fills in these rates. The rate can depend on the tax treaty; enter the one your office uses.
foreign_accounts_hint: The journal draft of a confirmed foreign invoice uses these accounts and goes to Luca. Sub-accounts are fine (e.g. 360.02). A code missing from the taxpayer's account plan shows as a warning on the entry. An empty code uses the default.
